# C6: The org pack

The org pack is everything an organisation configures, as files: the kinds of change and their flows, the gates and what they check, integration patterns, knowledge sources, the runtime (adapters and AI), procedures with their steps, test strategies and ecosystem profiles. A pack is validated file by file and across files; files it leaves out fall back to built-in defaults.

`roles.yaml`, and the role-based approval fields in `gates.yaml`, `change-types.yaml` and the change policy, are deprecated (ADR 0073): they still load and validate, and nothing reads them. The person is the metarepo's Git user, and a gate is approved when its hand-off PR merges.

Specification version 0.1.0.

| Version        | Value |
| -------------- | ----- |
| Schema version | 1     |

Where: `org-pack/pack.yaml`.

| Field              | Type                | Required | Values                                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------ | ------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `schemaVersion`    | 1                   | yes      |                                                             |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `name`             | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                                                             | Stable record id. Lowercase slug, safe as a file name on Linux, macOS and Windows (no ":" or "/"), so every record can live in its own file named by its id. |
| `version`          | string              | yes      |                                                             |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `owner`            | string              | yes      |                                                             | The one named owner after hand-over, normally the platform lead.                                                                                             |
| `reviewWindowDays` | integer             | no       | default `90`                                                | How often the pack itself must be reviewed.                                                                                                                  |
| `freshness`        | map of integer      | no       |                                                             | Days after which a record of this kind counts as stale and its owner is nudged.                                                                              |
| `classification`   | string (RecordId)[] | no       | default `["public","internal","confidential","restricted"]` | Data classification levels, lowest first.                                                                                                                    |

## Procedure

Where: `org-pack/process/procedures/<id>.yaml`.

A procedure (ADR 0033): a named, ordered list of steps in an outside system, each with typed inputs and outputs, whether it writes, and where the knowledge came from. Drafted from the organisation's how-to pages, uploads and past tickets, reviewed by a person, kept here. Additive C6 file kind: no schema version bump. `executors.allowed` is the allowlist: an executor may run this procedure only if it is named here (off by default).

| Field                       | Type                | Required | Values                                                                          | Description                                                                                                                                                  |
| --------------------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `schemaVersion`             | 1                   | yes      |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `id`                        | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                                                                                 | Stable record id. Lowercase slug, safe as a file name on Linux, macOS and Windows (no ":" or "/"), so every record can live in its own file named by its id. |
| `name`                      | string              | yes      |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `description`               | string              | no       |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `system`                    | enum                | yes      | `work-tracker`, `service-desk`, `git-host`, `wiki`, `notify`, `design`, `other` |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `template`                  | string (RecordId)   | no       |                                                                                 | The service-desk template (process/snow) this procedure raises, if any.                                                                                      |
| `steps`                     | object[]            | yes      |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].id`                | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                                                                                 | Stable record id. Lowercase slug, safe as a file name on Linux, macOS and Windows (no ":" or "/"), so every record can live in its own file named by its id. |
| `steps[].name`              | string              | yes      |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].kind`              | string (RecordId)   | yes      |                                                                                 | The kind of write or read, matching manual steps' `action` (submit-request, …).                                                                              |
| `steps[].writes`            | boolean             | yes      |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].inputs`            | map of any          | no       | default `{"type":"object"}`                                                     |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].outputs`           | map of any          | no       | default `{"type":"object"}`                                                     |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].instructions`      | string              | no       |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].evidence`          | object[]            | no       |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].evidence[].source` | string              | yes      |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].evidence[].line`   | integer             | no       |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `steps[].evidence[].note`   | string              | no       |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `executors`                 | object              | no       | default `{"allowed":[],"remoteHosts":[]}`                                       |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `executors.allowed`         | string (RecordId)[] | no       |                                                                                 | Executors allowed to run this procedure, by name. Empty: none (the default).                                                                                 |
| `executors.remoteHosts`     | string[]            | no       |                                                                                 | Hosts an http executor may be on besides 127.0.0.1. Empty: local only.                                                                                       |
| `source`                    | string              | yes      |                                                                                 | Where the procedure was drafted from (page, upload or ticket export).                                                                                        |
| `status`                    | enum                | no       | `draft`, `active`, `retired`; default `draft`                                   |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `reviewedBy`                | string              | no       |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
| `reviewedAt`                | string (date)       | no       |                                                                                 |                                                                                                                                                              |
